title: ‘I-angat natin bansa natin’: Castro tells Filipinos to avoid jobs that spread 'fake news'
summary: Palace Press Officer Claire Castro told Filipinos on Wednesday to avoid jobs that spread false information about the Philippines because of the damage it could do to the economy.
